The '''Massacre at Haruun Kal''', also known as the '''Haruun Kal Massacre''', was a military operation carried out by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Pierce]] of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] and his [[Pierce's black ops team|black ops unit]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]] sometime during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
